competitors.name: Local Competitor A
strengths: Established local reputation with strong Google reviews
Active social media presence with regular posts
Diverse service offerings covering multiple customer needs
weaknesses: Higher pricing with no visible value justification
No loyalty or rewards program for repeat customers
competitors.targetMarket: General local customers in the same area
theyHaveYouDont: Strong online review volume building trust
Professional website with online booking or ordering
Active community engagement and local partnerships

competitors.name: Local Competitor B
strengths: Modern, user-friendly website with easy navigation
Consistent branding across all marketing channels
Offers bundled service packages at competitive rates
weaknesses: Slow response time to online inquiries
Outdated interior or equipment reducing quality perception
theyHaveYouDont: Online booking or order management system

competitors.name: Local Competitor C
strengths: Premium positioning with high-quality service delivery
Specialized niche expertise that commands premium pricing
weaknesses: Pricing is too high for budget-conscious customers
Limited marketing visibility outside loyal customer base
No flexible pricing or entry-level service options
competitors.targetMarket: Premium customers seeking quality over price
theyHaveYouDont: Exclusive membership or VIP customer program
